title: Aegis — group and channel manager for Telegram
tagline: Keeps your groups and channels safe, tidy and lively. Every feature is free, in five languages.
no_bot: Open this page from Aegis (❓ Help → 🌐 About Aegis) to get the add buttons.
f_security: Anti-spam, anti-raid, a captcha for newcomers, flood and link guards, look-alike letters and scam links, and a shared blacklist across groups that use Aegis.
f_locks: Links, forwards, media, stickers, bots, languages and more — each with its own punishment, and locks by the clock.
f_setup: A setup wizard with presets for chat, study, shop and news groups; every setting in a clear panel, in private or right in the group.
f_notes: Saved answers (#rules), auto-replies to words and custom commands — with buttons.
f_mod: Warnings with steps, mute, ban and undo, reports, a log channel, appeals, admin levels and an audit trail.
f_channel: Scheduled posts, join requests with a captcha, invite-link statistics, and admins voting on direct messages before they are posted.
f_social: Activity statistics, points and levels, contests, polls and anonymous questions.
f_fun: Games and puzzles, fortune telling (Hafez, tarot), fonts, poems and film lines.
how_1: Add Aegis to your group or channel as an admin.
how_2: Send /config in the group, or open Aegis in a private chat and pick the group.
how_3: Choose a preset in the setup wizard — done. You can change anything later.
honest: Aegis does only what Telegram lets bots do: it must be an admin, and some features need particular admin rights. It has no access to members' private chats.
footer: Aegis runs on Telegram's serverless platform.
